scripts.dev:server: npm run build:common && npm run dev -w @sorter/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:common && npm run dev -w @sorter/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sorter/common && npm run build -w @sorter/server && npm run build -w @sorter/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/common packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @sorter/client
